# MOTTO Automotive full site guide

Canonical website: https://motto.ae/
Primary market: United Arab Emirates, with service across the Gulf, MENA and Africa.
Business: Manufacturer of custom dealer-branded automotive accessories.

## Trust and editorial policy

The educational library is written for automotive dealer, fleet, procurement, marketing and vehicle-preparation teams. Articles use MOTTO Automotive's manufacturing and supply experience, distinguish verified facts from recommendations, avoid unsupported test claims and link to official UAE sources where legal or licensing information is discussed. Product fit and legal requirements must be confirmed for the current vehicle, plate format, authority and purchase specification.

## Official-plate distinction

An official UAE registration plate is issued by a competent licensing authority. A number plate holder or frame is an accessory that secures or surrounds the official plate. A showroom plate is a non-registration display product. Neither accessory may be represented as, reproduce or replace an official plate. Federal reference: https://uaelegislation.gov.ae/en/legislations/2598

## UAE Number Plate Holder Sizes: A Fit Guide for Dealers and Fleets

- URL: https://motto.ae/blog/uae-number-plate-holder-sizes-fit-guide
- Search intent: UAE number plate holder sizes, number plate frame size UAE, dealer plate holders UAE, fleet number plate holders, short and long UAE number plates
- Quick answer: There is no safe one-size-fits-all ordering rule for every UAE vehicle. Licensing services recognise different plate formats, including short and long options, while front and rear mounting areas can differ by vehicle. Dealers and fleets should approve a holder from the actual issued plate format, vehicle recess, fixing points and sensor clearance before volume production.
- Detailed scope: The official registration plate is issued through the relevant licensing authority and carries the vehicle's registration information. A number plate holder or frame is an accessory that secures or surrounds that plate. The holder must never replace, reproduce or alter the official plate. That distinction matters when discussing size. Buyers are specifying an accessory around a government-issued item, not choosing the dimensions of the registration plate itself. The frame must preserve a clear view of every character, colour field and identifying detail. The UAE has more than one plate format. Dubai's Roads and Transport Authority, for example, lets customers select front and rear plate sizes and refers to short and long plates in its vehicle plate services. Other emirates and vehicle categories may have their own combinations. Online listings often present one familiar rectangular dimension as a universal answer. That is not a dependable procurement specification. Even when the official plate fits inside a nominal opening, the complete assembly still has to suit the vehicle's recess, mounting centres, curves, tailgate hardware, parking sensors and cameras. Input What to record Why it matters Issuing authority Emirate and plate category Identifies the official format being fitted Plate position Front or rear The same vehicle may use different formats at each end Vehicle data Make, model, model year and trim Bumpers and tailgates can change between variants Plate measurement Actual width, height, corner profile and thickness Confirms the holder's internal fit Mounting area Recess, fixing centres, curvature and depth Confirms the assembly fits the vehicle Clearance Cameras, sensors, lights, handles and vents Prevents interference with vehicle systems Group the fleet. Create a list by vehicle model, model year, trim, front position and rear position. Confirm the issued plate formats. Do not infer the format from a photograph or a previous order. Measure the actual plate and mounting area. Use a drawing with named dimensions rather than measurements in a message thread. Review the visible opening. Check that the holder cannot cover any official plate data. Fit a production-intent sample. Install it using the intended clips, screws or mounting system. Approve with evidence. Keep signed drawings and front, side and rear photographs for each approved application. For mixed fleets, a small family of holder variants is usually more reliable than forcing one frame onto every vehicle. The frame lip overlaps a digit, category mark or coloured field. The holder sits proud because the rear wall is deeper than the vehicle recess. Screw heads or clips mark the visible face of the official plate. The rear holder blocks a reversing camera, boot release or lamp. The frame twists on a curved bumper and releases one corner. A large dealer branding band reduces the usable plate opening. A supplier should be able to explain how these risks are checked during design and sampling, not only after delivery. Send the manufacturer a structured pack containing the vehicle matrix, official plate formats, target quantities, artwork, preferred branding process, colour, mounting method, packaging requirement and delivery schedule. State whether one sample is needed per vehicle group and identify who has authority to sign off fit. For a new programme, ask for the approved drawing revision to appear on the sample record and purchase order. That small control helps purchasing, the showroom and the factory work from the same version.

## Are Number Plate Frames Legal in the UAE?

- URL: https://motto.ae/blog/are-number-plate-frames-legal-uae
- Search intent: are number plate frames legal in UAE, UAE number plate holder law, Dubai number plate frame legal, licence plate visibility UAE, dealer plate holder compliance
- Quick answer: A number plate holder or frame is not the same as an official registration plate. A correctly fitted accessory frame may be used only when it does not cover, obscure, distort, alter or reduce the readability of the state-issued plate or conflict with its lawful installation. The final responsibility is to comply with current federal law, executive regulations and the relevant emirate licensing authority.
- Detailed scope: Important distinction The official registration plate is issued by a licensing authority and identifies the registered vehicle. A number plate holder or frame is a separately manufactured accessory that secures or surrounds that plate. MOTTO Automotive manufactures holders, not government registration plates. A decorative or dealer-branded frame does not gain permission to change the official plate. It should be designed around the plate's full visible area and installed without moving, cutting, recolouring, reproducing or covering registration information. Federal Decree-Law No. 14 of 2024 On Traffic Regulation is the current federal traffic law identified by the UAE Government. It took effect on 29 March 2025. Article 21 requires vehicles, other than stated exemptions, to have licence plates affixed according to the terms and specifications set by the Executive Regulations. Article 34 addresses serious plate misuse, including forging or imitating a plate, distorting, obliterating or altering plate data, transferring a plate without approval, and installing a plate in violation of the law or regulations. These provisions focus on the official plate and its lawful use. They do not turn an accessory frame into an official plate, and they do not excuse a frame that makes the official plate unclear or improperly installed. Before delivery or installation, inspect the complete assembly in daylight and from normal road-viewing angles: Every letter, number, colour field, mark and identifier on the official plate remains fully visible. The frame does not create glare, a false character, a shadow or a surface that could be mistaken for plate data. The holder secures the plate without bending, trimming, drilling through visible data or changing the plate face. No cover, film or tinted layer sits over the official plate. The assembly is securely attached in the intended location and does not obstruct lights, cameras or sensors. Dealer branding remains outside the official plate's readable field. Dubai RTA's guidance for vehicles carrying trunk-mounted bicycles illustrates the same principle. When bicycles or the rack obstruct the rear plate, RTA provides a service for an additional plate to be fixed to the rack. The solution is not to accept an obscured identifier. It is to preserve lawful plate visibility through the authorised process. The same reasoning should guide frame design. Styling, dealership promotion and mounting convenience are secondary to a clear, correctly installed official plate. Use a signed drawing that defines the holder's internal opening, branding band and retaining lip. Approve the sample with the actual plate format and the intended vehicle. For multi-emirate or mixed-fleet orders, keep separate approvals where plate formats or mounting areas differ. Ask the manufacturer to lock the approved artwork and dimensional revision into the production record. Receiving teams can then compare delivered frames with the signed sample rather than making a subjective visual decision. For a particular vehicle, plate category or unusual mounting arrangement, obtain guidance from the licensing authority in the emirate where the vehicle is registered. Dubai customers can use RTA's official vehicle plate services; other emirates have their own competent authorities. Legal note: This article provides general procurement and design information, not legal advice. Laws, Executive Regulations, service rules and enforcement practices can change. Check the current official sources and the relevant licensing authority before manufacture or installation.
- Author and reviewer: MOTTO Automotive, with technical review by the company's manufacturing team.

## How to Order Custom Dealer-Branded Number Plate Holders

- URL: https://motto.ae/blog/custom-dealer-branded-number-plate-holders-ordering-guide
- Search intent: custom dealer branded number plate holders, custom number plate frames UAE, dealer plate holder manufacturer, branded licence plate frames bulk, automotive dealer accessories UAE
- Quick answer: To order custom dealer-branded number plate holders, prepare a vehicle and plate-format matrix, vector artwork, colour and finish references, estimated quantities, packaging needs and delivery schedule. Approve a production-intent sample on the actual vehicle before releasing the full run.
- Detailed scope: Start with the programme, not the decoration. Record whether the holders are for new-car handovers, used vehicles, fleet replacements, an event, a particular marque or a group-wide rollout. Confirm the issuing emirates, expected front and rear plate formats, vehicle models and annual volume. This information tells the manufacturer whether one established holder will work or whether more than one fit variant is needed. A purchasing description such as "standard UAE plate frame" is too vague for a controlled order. Include the actual official plate format, front or rear position, vehicle recess measurements, fixing points and nearby sensors or cameras. Follow the process in the UAE number plate holder fit guide . The approved opening must leave every part of the official plate readable. This is particularly important when the branding band is deeper than a plain frame. Send the dealership or marque logo as a vector file such as AI, EPS, SVG or print-ready PDF. Add the official colour references, minimum clear space, approved wording, branch details if required and any co-branding rules. Do not rely on a low-resolution logo copied from a website. The manufacturer has to translate the artwork into a process that holds fine lines and spacing at a small physical size. The right process depends on artwork, quantity, durability and budget. Foil stamping can provide a crisp metallic or high-contrast premium result. Pad printing handles certain detailed or multi-colour graphics. Stickers may suit temporary or very short-life uses but add an exposed edge that must be evaluated. Ask for process-specific samples instead of approving only a digital mock-up. Our foil, pad printing and sticker comparison explains the trade-offs. The approval sample should use the intended polymer, colour, logo process, fixing method and packaging. Install it on the actual vehicle with the correct official plate format. Review fit, readability, logo position, colour, surface finish, closure and removal method. Record approval with photographs, sample date, drawing revision and the names of the authorised approvers. A signed physical master sample is especially useful for large or recurring orders. Commercial input Questions to settle Quantity Initial order, annual forecast, call-off lots and minimum reorder Packing Pairs or singles, protective layers, carton count and branch labels Inspection Approved sample, critical dimensions and acceptable appearance criteria Delivery One warehouse or multiple branches, target dates and receiving contacts Repeat orders Artwork control, tooling storage and revision process Your request should identify the company, project, vehicle applications, plate formats, estimated volume, branding files, finish, colour, packaging, destination, required sample date and production delivery date. Ask the supplier to separate one-time development or tooling costs from recurring unit and logistics costs. A complete brief produces a more accurate quotation and reduces the number of approval cycles. It also makes competing offers easier to compare on equal specifications.

## Number Plate Holder Manufacturer vs Reseller

- URL: https://motto.ae/blog/number-plate-holder-manufacturer-vs-reseller
- Search intent: number plate holder manufacturer UAE, plate frame supplier Dubai, manufacturer vs reseller automotive accessories, bulk number plate holders UAE, white label automotive accessories manufacturer
- Quick answer: A manufacturer controls one or more core production stages and can usually provide technical drawings, samples, process records and change control. A reseller sources finished goods from another party. Resellers can suit simple stock purchases, but dealer-branded or fit-critical programmes benefit from knowing who controls the mould, material, decoration and quality release.
- Detailed scope: A manufacturer has direct control over defined production processes, such as product engineering, tooling, moulding, decoration, inspection or packaging. It should be able to identify what is done in-house and what, if anything, is handled by an approved specialist. A reseller buys a finished or nearly finished product from another supplier and sells it onward. A reseller can still provide a useful service, but the buyer should understand the additional layer and who ultimately owns the technical answers. Area Direct manufacturer Reseller Fit changes Can assess tooling or design changes directly Must relay the request to the source Artwork control Links the approved file to the production process Depends on upstream controls Root-cause analysis Can inspect the process and records May have limited factory access Repeat consistency Can retain master sample, drawing and process settings Depends on the continuity of its source Stock simplicity May require production minimums Can be convenient for generic items held in stock Commercial chain Direct technical and commercial relationship Adds an intermediary margin and communication step Which processes are performed at your own facility? Who owns and stores the mould or tooling? Can we see a dimensioned drawing and a production-intent sample? How are artwork revisions approved and prevented from mixing? What incoming, in-process and final inspections are recorded? Who investigates a fit or finish complaint? Can you support branch call-offs and repeat orders using the same master standard? Clear answers matter more than the label a supplier uses in its marketing. A lower unit quote can be outweighed by a second sample cycle, inconsistent logo colour, unplanned sorting, replacement stock, branch repacking or a late launch. Add development, freight, duty where applicable, inspection, packaging, minimum order quantities and failure risk to the comparison. For a recurring dealer programme, also ask what happens after one year. A supplier with controlled drawings, tooling and artwork can reproduce the approved product without starting the discovery process again. A reseller can be suitable when the product is generic, immediately available, low risk and not customised for vehicle fit or brand presentation. It may also consolidate many small accessory lines into one shipment. For a branded plate holder placed on every customer vehicle, however, the ability to speak directly with the team controlling fit, material and decoration often reduces long-term risk. Score each bidder on technical capability, sample quality, capacity, change control, inspection, packaging, delivery, responsiveness and total cost. Visit the facility where practical, or request a live process review with evidence tied to your product. Avoid accepting unrelated factory photographs as proof of capability. The goal is not to exclude every intermediary. It is to make the supply chain visible enough to assign responsibility and protect the approved standard.
- Author and reviewer: MOTTO Automotive, with technical review by the company's manufacturing team.
## Foil Stamping, Pad Printing or Stickers for Plate Frames

- URL: https://motto.ae/blog/plate-frame-branding-foil-stamping-pad-printing-stickers
- Search intent: foil stamping plate frames, pad printing number plate holders, stickers for licence plate frames, branded plate holder finish, custom plate frame printing UAE
- Quick answer: Foil stamping is well suited to crisp, premium metallic or solid-colour branding on an appropriate frame surface. Pad printing can reproduce fine or multi-colour artwork on shaped areas. Stickers offer flexibility and low setup for temporary applications but introduce an exposed film and edge. The right choice should be confirmed with production-intent samples and durability checks.
- Detailed scope: Foil stamping uses a heated or process-specific die to transfer a pigmented or metallic foil onto the prepared branding area. On a well-designed holder, it can create sharp lettering and a premium contrast without adding a sticker edge. The artwork should respect the practical limits of the die, including minimum line thickness, spacing and the flatness of the stamping surface. Fine artwork that looks clear on screen may need adjustment at plate-frame scale. Pad printing transfers ink from an etched plate to the product with a flexible silicone pad. Because the pad conforms to the component, the process can decorate slightly curved or recessed areas and may support detailed or multi-colour artwork through multiple passes. Ink selection, surface preparation, curing and colour registration all matter. Buyers should approve the result on the actual polymer, not on a flat colour proof. A printed or cut sticker applies the artwork as a separate adhesive film. It can support photographic detail, variable information and short runs with little tooling. This makes it useful for temporary campaigns, samples or applications with a deliberately short service period. The trade-off is an exposed edge and a separate adhesive system. Heat, UV, washing, dust and cleaning chemicals can affect the film, print or bond. A sticker should not be presented as equivalent to an integrated finish without application-specific testing. Factor Foil stamping Pad printing Sticker Visual character Crisp solid or metallic finish Printed colour and fine detail Wide graphic and variable-data freedom Surface Best on a controlled stamping area Can suit some shaped surfaces Needs a clean area with enough bond surface Setup Die and process setup Plate, ink and colour setup Artwork, print and cutting setup Exposed edge No separate film edge No separate film edge Yes Good fit Premium dealer wordmarks and repeat programmes Detailed or multi-colour branding Temporary, variable or trial applications Begin with how long the frame should remain presentable, where it will operate, how often it will be washed, the exact artwork and the expected order volume. A permanent dealer frame in Gulf conditions usually needs a more durable integrated process than an event sample. Then compare total programme cost. Include dies or plates, colour changes, rejected parts, setup quantities, replacement risk and the cost of a finish that no longer represents the brand after months on the road. Colour and metallic appearance under daylight and showroom lighting Logo dimensions, spacing, alignment and edge definition Adhesion to the intended production material Resistance to representative heat, UV exposure, water and cleaning chemicals Repeat consistency across the proposed production quantity Packaging that prevents decorated faces from rubbing in transit Ask the supplier to document the approved material, finish and artwork revision together. Changing any one of them can change the result.
- Author and reviewer: MOTTO Automotive, with technical review by the company's manufacturing team.
## How Custom 3D Automotive Badges Are Made

- URL: https://motto.ae/blog/how-custom-3d-automotive-badges-are-made
- Search intent: how custom 3D automotive badges are made, custom car badge manufacturer UAE, 3D chrome car emblems, dealer car badges custom, automotive emblem production
- Quick answer: Custom 3D automotive badges are developed through artwork engineering, dimensional design, tooling or forming, substrate production, surface finishing, adhesive or fixing selection, inspection and protective packaging. The exact process changes with badge shape, finish, quantity and where it will be installed.
- Detailed scope: The starting pack should contain vector artwork, colour references, target width and height, preferred depth, finish, installation surface, vehicle models, quantity and packaging requirements. State whether the badge is decorative dealer branding, a model identifier, an event item or an interior application. Photographs of the mounting area help the manufacturer understand panel curvature, nearby body lines and the available flat bond area. Thin strokes, sharp internal corners and tiny gaps may work in print but fail when converted into a raised part. The manufacturer reviews minimum wall widths, bridges, recesses, edge radii, draft requirements and how separate letters will be positioned. This is also the stage to decide whether the badge will be one connected piece, individual characters held in a placement template, or an emblem on a concealed carrier. A dimensional drawing or prototype establishes the outer dimensions, surface relief, back profile and attachment area. Depending on the product and volume, production may use dedicated tooling, moulding, forming, machining or a combination of processes. Buyers should approve a physical sample on the actual panel before authorising the production tool or full run. A badge that is correct on a flat desk may not sit correctly on a curved tailgate. The selected substrate is formed into the approved geometry and prepared for the visual finish. Chrome-style, satin, gloss, painted, printed and colour-filled appearances each require different preparation and inspection. Surface defects become more obvious on reflective finishes, so cleanliness, edge quality and handling are critical. A premium result should show controlled highlights without pits, scratches, haze or uneven colour. Many dealer badges use pressure-sensitive automotive adhesive, while some applications use mechanical fixings or a combined method. Adhesive selection must consider the badge material, vehicle paint or trim surface, bond area, curvature, expected temperature and installation process. A placement template can control spacing and alignment. The installer also needs a defined cleaning and application method, including suitable surface condition and pressure. Check dimensions, depth and back profile against the approved drawing. Compare colour, gloss and surface appearance with the master sample. Verify that adhesive is complete, protected and within its controlled storage life. Inspect character spacing and template orientation. Use protective packaging that prevents parts from rubbing or shifting. Identify the artwork and product revision on the pack or production record. Ask for a dimensioned drawing, finish sample, installed sample, attachment specification, installation instructions, packaging sample and agreed quality criteria. For recurring programmes, confirm tooling ownership, master sample storage and the process for approving a logo or finish change. These controls turn a custom badge from a one-off craft item into a repeatable automotive accessory. Procurement should also separate one-time development from repeat production. The first order may include artwork engineering, prototypes, tools or placement fixtures. Later orders should reference the same approved revision unless the dealer formally requests a change. This makes quotations easier to compare and prevents an apparently small artwork update from entering production without fit and finish review.
- Author and reviewer: MOTTO Automotive, with technical review by the company's manufacturing team.
## Custom Car Badges for Gulf Conditions

- URL: https://motto.ae/blog/custom-car-badges-gulf-conditions
- Search intent: custom car badges Gulf conditions, heat resistant car emblems UAE, automotive badge adhesive hot climate, custom chrome car badges Dubai, dealer badges UAE
- Quick answer: A Gulf-ready custom car badge should be specified as a complete system. The badge body, decorative finish, adhesive, panel surface, cleaning method and installation conditions all affect performance in heat, UV, dust, humidity and repeated washing. Validate the production-intent badge on representative vehicle surfaces before rollout.
- Detailed scope: Record whether the badge will sit on painted metal, glass, textured trim, a grille, wheel cover or an interior surface. Note direct sun exposure, panel curvature, wash practices, expected service life and whether vehicles operate near the coast or in dusty fleet conditions. Different mounting locations create different stresses. A small badge on a flat tailgate is not the same application as a long wordmark stretched across a curved plastic panel. The substrate must hold its geometry without excessive distortion, while the finish must remain bonded and visually consistent. Reflective chrome-style finishes reveal scratches and surface defects quickly. Painted and printed areas need colour and adhesion appropriate to the intended exposure. Ask the supplier to identify the production material and finish stack used in the approved sample. A similar-looking prototype made by another process is not enough for durability approval. Pressure-sensitive adhesive performance depends on surface energy, cleanliness, contact area, pressure, application temperature and time before loading. Curved panels can create continuous peel stress, especially at the ends of a long badge. The badge back should provide sufficient, even bond area. The installer should receive instructions for cleaning, positioning, application pressure and any required dwell period. Avoid improvising with household cleaners or applying over wax, polish, dust or moisture. There is no useful claim such as "Gulf proof" without defined conditions and acceptance criteria. Agree a test plan appropriate to the programme, which may include: High-temperature exposure and thermal cycling UV or accelerated weathering evaluation Humidity and water exposure Representative detergent and cleaning-chemical contact Adhesion checks after conditioning Installed-vehicle trials on the intended surfaces Define what passes: no lifting edges, cracking, unacceptable colour change, finish separation or loss of alignment. Confirm the correct badge and vehicle application. Inspect the panel for repairs, texture, contamination or excessive curvature. Clean with the approved method and allow the surface to dry. Use the placement template and reference points. Apply even pressure across the complete bond area. Respect the specified temperature and post-application handling time. Simple photographic work instructions can prevent variation across branches and installers. Lifting at one end can point to curvature, low pressure or insufficient bond area. Uniform adhesive release may indicate surface contamination or an incompatible adhesive. Finish peeling can indicate a preparation or process problem. Scratches inside sealed packaging suggest parts were allowed to rub during transit. Keep failed parts, installation dates and vehicle details. Evidence helps the supplier separate product, application and handling causes. Do not replace a failed badge and discard the evidence immediately. Photograph its location before removal, record the vehicle model, panel material, installation branch, date and operating conditions, then protect both the badge and any released adhesive liner. A disciplined review supports a targeted correction rather than a broad, unsupported conclusion about the whole batch.
- Author and reviewer: MOTTO Automotive, with technical review by the company's manufacturing team.
## Dealer Handover Gifts and Branded Keychains

- URL: https://motto.ae/blog/dealer-handover-gifts-branded-keychains
- Search intent: dealer handover gifts UAE, branded car keychains for dealers, custom automotive keychains Dubai, new car delivery gifts, dealer branded key rings bulk
- Quick answer: A dealer handover keychain should feel appropriate to the vehicle and brand, protect the key, remain comfortable in daily use and arrive presentation-ready. Specify materials, logo method, hardware, packaging, branch quantities and replenishment rules as one programme rather than buying the keychain and box separately.
- Detailed scope: Decide whether the item is a standard gift with every vehicle, a premium upgrade for selected models, a fleet welcome pack or a campaign item. Match the design and cost to the customer journey. A luxury showroom may prioritise refined materials and a rigid presentation box, while a fleet programme may value durability, compact packaging and simple replenishment. Element Decision Body Leather, leather alternative, metal or combined construction Hardware Ring size, clasp, finish, edge quality and key compatibility Branding Embossing, engraving, printed mark, badge or metal insert Comfort Weight, pocket feel, sharp edges and one-hand use Packaging Box, sleeve, insert, care card and presentation orientation Distribution Carton count, branch label, call-off quantity and reorder level Use approved artwork and colours, but avoid covering every surface with logos. A restrained mark, coordinated hardware finish and packaging aligned with showroom materials often feel more premium than oversized branding. Review the keychain beside the actual vehicle key and handover folder. Scale, colour and texture should belong to the same experience. Rings and clasps open without excessive force and return securely. Edges are smooth and do not scratch the key, hand or interior trim. The logo remains legible at normal viewing distance. Leather edges, stitching and bonded layers are even. Metal finishes are free from sharp burrs, haze and handling marks. The item stays fixed in its box during branch delivery. Customer initials, vehicle model or delivery date can make a gift more personal, but variable data changes the workflow. Decide who submits the data, how spelling is approved, when production is locked and how mistakes are replaced. Collect only the information needed for fulfilment and handle it through the dealership's approved privacy process. For faster handovers, many groups choose a consistent dealer-branded keychain and personalise a removable card instead. A good gift fails if the right branch runs out on a delivery weekend. Set a pack quantity, minimum stock level, reorder contact and lead-time allowance. Use outer-carton labels that identify design, vehicle programme, quantity and revision without opening the box. For group programmes, review monthly vehicle deliveries by branch and hold a sensible buffer against actual usage rather than distributing equal quantities everywhere. Ask delivery teams about presentation time, defects, packaging waste and customer reaction. Monitor replacement requests and unused stock. If customer experience surveys mention the handover pack positively, retain the elements that work instead of changing the design each season. The goal is a useful, brand-consistent detail that makes the final stage of the sale feel considered. Set a simple review after the first delivery cycle. Compare the number of vehicle handovers with keychains issued, damaged packs, branch transfers and reorder requests. This reveals whether the pack quantity is practical and whether the gift is reaching the intended customer. It also gives procurement evidence for the next order instead of relying on impressions alone.

## Custom Car Sunshades in the UAE

- URL: https://motto.ae/blog/custom-car-sunshades-uae
- Search intent: custom car sunshades UAE, branded car sunshades Dubai, dealer car sunshades bulk, custom windshield sunshade UAE, automotive promotional sunshades
- Quick answer: For custom car sunshades in the UAE, specify the vehicle group, windscreen coverage, folded and open dimensions, construction, reflective orientation, edge finish, print artwork, storage method, packaging and branch quantities. Approve a production-intent sample inside the intended vehicles before ordering in bulk.
- Detailed scope: List the vehicle makes, models and model years that will receive the sunshade. Decide whether one adaptable size will cover a broad range or whether premium models need dedicated variants. Note windscreens with large sensor housings, dash cameras, unusual mirror mounts or steep rake angles. Also define the use: retail gift, showroom add-on, service campaign, fleet issue or paid accessory. The intended use affects construction, packaging and how much time staff can spend during handover. A sunshade should cover the useful glass area without forcing material against the mirror, cameras or sensor housing. It needs enough structure to remain in position with the approved support method, yet it should not be awkward to remove or fold. Check the stored size inside the vehicle. A shade that protects the windscreen but does not fit in the door pocket, seat-back pocket or boot location defined by the dealer may be left at home. Install the sample in every representative windscreen group. Check coverage, mirror and sensor clearance, and stability. Open and fold it several times using normal showroom handling. Ask the supplier how production variation will be checked for open dimensions, print position, edge finish, fold function and pack count. ## How Sunshades Protect Vehicle Interiors in UAE Heat

- URL: https://motto.ae/blog/car-sunshades-protect-interiors-uae-heat
- Search intent: how car sunshades protect interiors UAE heat, windshield sunshade benefits Dubai, protect car dashboard from sun UAE, car interior heat sunshade, UAE vehicle interior UV protection
- Quick answer: A windscreen sunshade reflects or blocks part of the sunlight entering a parked vehicle through the front glass. Correct coverage can reduce direct exposure on the dashboard, steering wheel, display and front trim, which supports comfort and interior care. It does not make a parked vehicle safe for a child, pet or occupant, and the cabin can still become dangerously hot.
- Detailed scope: Sunlight carries visible and infrared energy through the windscreen. Interior surfaces absorb part of that energy and warm up, then transfer heat to the surrounding air. A shade placed close to the glass reflects or blocks part of the incoming radiation before it reaches the dashboard and front trim. Performance depends on coverage, orientation, material, gaps around the edges and the rest of the vehicle. Heat also enters through the roof, side and rear glass, and warm outside air surrounds the car. Dashboard and instrument area: receives less direct front-glass exposure. Steering wheel and controls: can be more comfortable to touch after parking. Centre display and trim: gains shade from repeated direct sunlight. Front upholstery: may receive less direct light, depending on shade coverage and sun angle. A sunshade supports a broader care routine. Cleaners and dressings should still be suitable for the actual interior material, and vulnerable items should not be left on the dashboard. A shade that collapses, leaves a large central gap or is installed backwards will not perform as intended. Choose a design that covers the practical windscreen area, clears the mirror and driver-assistance sensors, and stays supported by the vehicle's sun visors or approved retention method. Do not force the shade against cameras, sensor covers or delicate accessories. A vehicle-fit review should consider these features before a dealer orders custom sizes. Evaluate the reflective face, opacity, internal support, edge binding, fold durability and stored size. A shade used daily should recover its shape after folding and should not leave loose fibres or abrasive edges near the dashboard. For branded dealer products, print quality must be considered alongside function. Ink or decoration should not transfer to glass or trim under representative use and storage. A sunshade is not an occupant-safety device Never leave a child, pet or vulnerable person in a parked vehicle. A sunshade does not keep the cabin at a safe temperature, replace air conditioning or justify remaining in a closed car. Drivers should remove and store the shade completely before moving the vehicle. It must not obstruct the windscreen, mirrors or driver visibility while driving. Park in covered shade where it is safely and lawfully available. Remove portable items that can be damaged by heat. Install the shade with the intended reflective face toward the windscreen. Open it fully and support it without stressing sensors or the mirror. Before driving, remove, fold and secure it so it cannot move around the cabin. For dealership programmes, include a small use and safety card in the pack. Clear instructions increase the chance that customers use the accessory correctly.
- Author and reviewer: MOTTO Automotive, with technical review by the company's manufacturing team.
## Custom Showroom Plates for UAE Dealers

- URL: https://motto.ae/blog/custom-showroom-plates-uae-dealers
- Search intent: custom showroom plates UAE dealers, dealer display plates Dubai, custom car showroom signs, vehicle photography display plates, branded demo plates UAE
- Quick answer: A custom showroom plate is a non-registration display accessory for vehicles in controlled settings such as showroom floors, photography bays, launches and exhibitions. It must never be represented as or substituted for an official state-issued registration plate on a vehicle used on public roads.
- Detailed scope: Display use only A showroom plate is a branded display sign. It is not issued by a licensing authority, does not register the vehicle and must not imitate, reproduce or replace an official UAE registration plate for road use. When a vehicle is driven where official registration plates are required, it must carry the authorised plates in the required manner. The display plate should be removed or used only in a location and manner approved by the responsible dealer team. New-model launches and media previews Showroom floor and window displays Approved vehicle photography and video sets Motor shows, exhibitions and private events Used-car presentation with dealer or programme branding Model-name, trim or campaign identification in a controlled display Define overall dimensions, corner shape, thickness, substrate, finish, artwork, front and rear appearance, edge treatment, mounting method and viewing distance. State whether the plate will be installed for hours, moved daily or reused across a long campaign. For close-up vehicle photography, surface flatness, clean edges and controlled reflections matter. For events, handling resistance and quick tool-free changes may be more important. Keep the message short enough to read at the intended distance. Use approved vector logos and define safe areas around fixings, clips and frames. Dark gloss surfaces can reflect lights and people, while highly reflective metallic finishes may distract in photography. Test the chosen finish in the actual environment. Create separate artwork codes for model names, campaign versions and languages. This reduces the risk of the wrong plate appearing on a vehicle during a launch. The display plate may fit an existing holder, use a concealed temporary mount or attach to an approved display fixture. The method should not scratch paint, load a grille, interfere with sensors or encourage staff to drill unapproved holes. Provide handling instructions and identify which vehicle applications have been approved. Inspect reusable mounts and plates before every event. Install the production-intent plate on the representative vehicle. Review from showroom viewing distance and through the camera. Check alignment, reflections, mounting stability and sensor clearance. Confirm that all wording is display branding, not an imitation of registration data. Approve protective sleeves, carton labels and branch allocation. Current UAE traffic law requires licence plates to be affixed according to applicable terms and specifications and addresses forging, imitating, altering and unlawfully installing official plates. Dealer operating procedures should make the display-only status unmistakable and assign responsibility for removing display plates before road use. Legal note: This is general product and procurement information, not legal advice. Confirm any unusual vehicle movement or display arrangement with the relevant licensing and event authorities.
- Author and reviewer: MOTTO Automotive, with technical review by the company's manufacturing team.
## Bulk Automotive Accessories Procurement Checklist

- URL: https://motto.ae/blog/bulk-automotive-accessories-procurement-checklist
- Search intent: bulk automotive accessories procurement checklist, automotive accessories supplier UAE, dealer accessories bulk order Dubai, fleet accessories procurement, automotive supplier quality checklist
- Quick answer: For a bulk automotive accessories purchase, define the application, vehicle fit, artwork, materials, finish, quantity, approved sample, quality criteria, packaging, delivery plan, ownership of tooling and change-control process before issuing the order. Compare suppliers on total landed and operational cost, not unit price alone.
- Detailed scope: Product purpose, customer and installation point Vehicle makes, models, years and front or rear applications where relevant Issuing emirate and official plate format for plate-holder projects Target quantity, annual forecast, branch allocation and reorder pattern Named technical, brand, commercial and final approvers A single project owner should maintain the approved files and decisions even when several departments contribute. Record dimensions, tolerances where required, material, colour, finish, artwork revision, mounting or attachment method, expected service environment, individual packaging and outer-carton details. Use photographs and drawings, but do not let them replace written requirements. For product-specific support, use the guides on dealer-branded plate holders , 3D badges and custom sunshades . Identify what is manufactured in-house and what is subcontracted. Confirm capacity for launch volume and recurring replenishment. Review tooling ownership, storage and maintenance. Ask how artwork and specification revisions are controlled. Review inspection equipment, records and complaint handling. Confirm business, contact, delivery and payment details. A transparent reseller may still qualify, but responsibility and upstream control should be clear. The sample should use the intended material, tooling, decoration, attachment and packaging. Test it in the real application, such as on the vehicle, key, windscreen or showroom mount. Record the sample revision, date, approvers and any limits of approval. Keep one signed master sample with the buyer and one with the supplier for visual products. Pair it with measurable criteria for dimensions, fit and pack quantity. Cost area Include Development Design, samples, tooling, dies, plates and revisions Product Unit price by volume break and expected rejection allowance Packaging Individual pack, inserts, branch labels and outer cartons Logistics Freight, duty where applicable, storage and branch distribution Operations Receiving inspection, repacking, installation time and replacements Risk Launch delay, obsolete artwork, fit failures and excess minimum stock Define critical fit and safety characteristics, visual standards, inspection points, sampling approach, defect categories and evidence required at shipment. State how non-conforming goods will be contained, reported, replaced or credited. Use objective language. "Premium quality" is not an inspection criterion. "Logo centred within the approved zone and matching signed master sample" is closer to one. Confirm pieces per bag, box and carton; pair orientation; protective layers; moisture considerations; barcode or product code; artwork revision; branch name; and carton weight. Run a pack-out trial so parts do not rub, bend or arrive mixed. For phased rollouts, define call-off notice, delivery windows and the stock buffer. Separate launch stock from routine replenishment so the first shipment does not consume the whole annual forecast. Check product code, revision, quantity and carton condition on arrival. Compare a sample with the signed master and critical dimensions. Run a fit or function check from each delivered lot where appropriate. Record defects by lot and retain photographs and affected samples. Review installer and branch feedback after launch. Require written approval before any material, tooling, artwork or process change. Product purpose and application defined Vehicle and fit matrix attached Vector artwork and colour standards attached Material, finish and attachment specified Quantities and delivery locations listed Production-intent sample required Quality and packaging requirements included Tooling ownership and change control requested Development and recurring costs separated
- Author and reviewer: MOTTO Automotive, with technical review by the company's manufacturing team.
